arguments.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one transparent dialogue portrait for a low-resolution medieval CRPG, target logical canvas 74 pixels wide by 100 pixels high. This is a SUBSTANTIVE REDRAW of the identity reference, not a crop or enlargement of the old cute figure. Reference image 1 is only identity/history. Reference images 2–5 (Mara v2, Iwo v1, Leiya v2 maxcoverage, Tore v1) define the pixel-art portrait style and very tight large-head framing. Match their face scale, adult facial anatomy, hard-edged broad pixel clusters, earth colors, chiselled nose and cheek planes. Aim to look like a native 74x100 portrait shown enlarged with NEAREST scaling: confidently placed large flat pixel shapes, limited coherent color ramps, no smooth painting, no gradient, no noisy dithering. The complete head fills almost all the width and about 90% of the height; chin near row 83–87, with a SHORT NECK and only a NARROW STRIP OF CLOTHING in the lowest 10–14 rows. Leave 1–3 logical transparent pixels around the hair crown and ears; hair and ears completely inside canvas. Tiny shoulders may exit the bottom corners. No bust, no torso, no hands, no props, no background, no vignette, no outline box, no text. Natural human eye size: small dark eyelids, dark iris, minimal muted sclera, NEVER large white eye patches. Face carries the expression in the mouth and lid shapes, never automatically copy worried V-shaped brows from the references. Use at most 32 deliberately chosen visible colors. Transparent background with clean silhouette.

Subject identity: Vimon / 维松, BRY-NPC-VIMON, a man in his mid-to-late 40s who voluntarily left his old night watch. Preserve reference 1's narrow angular face, long straight projecting nose, slight graying chin/moustache shadow, understated firm straight mouth and weathered mature character. IMPORTANT CURRENT CARD OVERRIDE: his hair is SHAVED EXTREMELY SHORT, close-cropped dark-brown and gray scalp; remove the old reference's tied hair and long curls entirely. No ponytail, no long fringe, no beard mass. Render the scalp as 2–3 broad quiet planes, not stippled hair follicles. Render faint stubble as one or two broad shadow shapes, not individual hairs. Slight three-quarter angle looking viewer's left; calm level eyebrows, narrow steady dark eyes, closed lips slightly offset as if stating a firm plain conclusion. His expression is self-possessed practical refusal, NOT worry, anger, regret, heroic pride or sadness. Current card clothing: a faded slate-blue old watch cloak repurposed into a short civilian coat, visible only as the lowest narrow collar margin, with a single replacement bone button and an oatmeal inner shirt. No uniform insignia, medal, armor, weapon, badge, award ceremony, or glory. Old chilblain marks are on back of neck and outside this crop; do not invent facial scars. Emphasize long bridge of nose, older cheek hollow, small lower-lid shelf and angular jaw using a few hard-edged connected warm-earth clusters. Keep the ears whole. The sparse close-shaved hair makes his silhouette visibly distinct from the four reference faces.
